name: G479, payday edge: the bill and the money are both dated payday, so they belong to the next period and the figure is the balance now

expected.notes: Today is Thu 19 Nov 2026 and pay is the last Friday, so payday is Fri 27 Nov (8 days away): the window is days 0 to 7 (19 to 26 Nov), and anything dated on payday belongs to the next period. Harbour Current holds 34.89; the 77.91 bill and the 649.59 credit are both dated Fri 27 Nov, which is payday (day 8). G479 (Kevin 2026-11-19, option A): Left to spend is what can be spent without any payment failing. Each counted current account contributes its LOWEST balance before payday (the lowest running balance after any of its payments, or its closing balance if that is lower, or its overdraft), money in counted only from its expected date; a dip below zero is a shortfall and reduces the total, never floored away (contribution = max(0, figure), uncovered shortfall = max(0, -figure), the total is their signed sum). Payday itself belongs to the next pay period (no last-day lookahead, G359, G360), so neither the bill nor the credit is in the window: the account has no events and contributes its balance, 34.89. No dip, no move, at risk 0.
